Sir, binary search samjhiye step-by-step!

🎯 Simple Definition:
Binary search ek smart technique hai jo sorted array mein element dhundti hai by dividing search space in half.

📚 Real-World Analogy:
Dictionary mein word dhundna - aap middle page khol ke dekh te hain, phir decide karte hain left ya right jaana hai!

🔢 Live Example:
Array: [1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13]
Target: 7

Step 1: Middle = 7 (index 3) → Found it! ✅
Agar 5 dhundte: Middle = 7 → "Too high" → Left half mein dhundo

💻 Working Code:
```python
def binary_search(arr, target):
    left, right = 0, len(arr) - 1
    
    while left <= right:
        mid = (left + right) // 2
        
        if arr[mid] == target:
            return mid  # Mil gaya!
        elif arr[mid] < target:
            left = mid + 1  # Right side dhundo
        else:
            right = mid - 1  # Left side dhundo
    
    return -1  # Nahi mila
```

🌍 Real Applications:
Google search, phone contacts, library systems, database queries!

Sir, recursion ka matlab kya hai?

🎯 Definition: Recursion ek tarah ka algorithm hai jismein ek function apne aap ko call karta hai, lekin phir woh function apne aap ko dobara call karne se pehle, apne aap ko solve karta hai.

📚 Real Example: Ek bachcha apne maa ko khaana khilane ke liye bolta hai. Maa bachche ko bolta hai ki woh aapke bade bhai se puchhe, aur woh bade bhai bhi maa se bolta hai, lekin jab woh maa se puchhta hai to maa kahte hain ki woh apne dadaji se puchhe. Is tarah se bachcha apne dadaji se puchhta hai. Yeh recursion ka ek aisa example hai.

🔢 How it works: Recursion ka process nimnalikhit hai:
- Ek function apne aap ko call karta hai.
- Function apne aap ko solve karta hai, aur phir apne aap ko call karta hai.
- Is process ko repeat karte rahe, jab tak koi condition nahi purn hoti hai.
- Jab condition purn hoti hai, to function apne aap ko stop karta hai aur result return karta hai.

🌍 Applications: Recursion ka upyog Fibonacci series, binary search, array traversal, tree traversal aur graph traversal jaise kai algorithms mein kiya jata hai.
